Name: Upgraded Horse - Horse friendship and speed levels
Author: suns13
Description:
[b]Added mechanics including friendship level with horse, feed your horse.
Fed horses get a speed bonus based on your friendship level with the horse.

[/b][b]Open up the horse menu by clicking the horse icon in the main menu or by pressing "H"
[/b]
[b]Once a day, right click your horse with food (anything that provides health) to feed it.
[/b]Cooked food gives extra exp.

When fed, your horse gains 1 speed per each friendship heart (capped at 3).
Once you have 4 hearts, if you do not feed your horse that day, you will lose exp.

[b]NOTE (IMPORTANT IF YOU HAD V1)[/b]
[b]When updating from v1 to v1.1, delete the save file giving you an error
- find the file directory through the SMAPI console when loading up the game
- delete the save files under the following directory
[/b]- IE. 'C:\Users\X\AppData\Roaming\StardewValley\Saves\.smapi\mod-data/user.upgradedhorse'
- IE. /Users/X/.config/StardewValley/Saves/.smapi/mod-data/user.upgradedhorse

Required: SMAPI

Installation
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
